points: Nevuchadnetzar breaks through the walls by the 17th of Tammuz, and it takes three more weeks of fighting just to reach the Bais Hamikdash.
Tzidkiyahu flees through a secret tunnel toward Yericho. The Gemara says the Babylonians chased a deer to the cave's exit, and caught him there, just as Yirmiyahu said.
His children are killed in front of him, he is blinded and taken to Bavel. Nevuzaradan gives the fields and vineyards to the poorest Jews.
Yirmiyahu, persecuted by his own people, is protected by the Babylonians and handed to Gedaliah ben Achikam. Eved Melech, the slave who saved him, is promised he'll survive.
The chapter starts with the king falling and ends with a slave being saved. Galus is an upside-down world, and we still live in it.
